wl.cli.intro: Replay every capture of this endpoint to a server on your machine, in order, as it arrives.
wl.cli.install.title: Install
wl.cli.install.release: Release {{version}} from GitHub. Download the archive and the checksum file into one folder.
wl.cli.install.verifyStep: Check the archive against the checksum file:
wl.cli.install.installStep: Unpack it and install the binary:
wl.cli.install.source.body: Needs Rust 1.98 or newer. Cargo builds the same binary from the repository and puts it into its bin folder, ~/.cargo/bin by default.
wl.cli.token.title: Token
wl.cli.token.body: Only protected and SSO endpoints need a token. Anonymous endpoints work without one.
wl.cli.token.create: Create a token on the API tokens page
wl.cli.token.env: Keep the token out of the command: export it as WEBHOOKS_LIVE_TOKEN in the shell that runs the CLI. The command below never contains a token.
wl.cli.token.login: Or store it once with login: the CLI reads the token from stdin and keeps it in your user config directory, readable only by you.
wl.cli.run.title: Run
wl.cli.run.intro: Pick the local port, an optional path prefix and where to start. The command is built from this endpoint's capture URL.
wl.cli.run.port.label: Local port
wl.cli.run.prefix.label: Path prefix on the local server
wl.cli.run.prefix.hint: Optional, for example /hooks. Captured paths are added after it.
wl.cli.run.prefix.invalid: Start with / and use only letters, digits and . _ ~ - / characters.
wl.cli.run.start.resume: Resume after the last forwarded capture (default)
wl.cli.run.start.now: Only captures that arrive from now on
wl.cli.run.start.all: The whole history that the server still holds
wl.cli.run.dryRun: Dry run: print what would be sent, send nothing
wl.cli.run.command.label: Command
wl.cli.run.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields to get the command.
wl.cli.run.error: The endpoint could not be loaded, so the command cannot be built.
wl.cli.run.hint: Captures replay in order. The CLI resumes after a disconnect.
wl.cli.warning.title: Local targets are not checked
wl.cli.warning.body: --to is not checked by the SSRF guard that the server applies to its own forwarding. The CLI runs on your machine and sends every replayed request to whatever --to names, including localhost and private networks. Anyone who can send to this endpoint reaches that service through your machine, so point --to only at a service you would accept those requests on.
wl.cli.trouble.title: If it does not work
wl.cli.trouble.exit3: Exit code 3: the server refused the token. Check that WEBHOOKS_LIVE_TOKEN is set in this shell and that the token is not revoked.
wl.cli.trouble.exit4: Exit code 4: the endpoint is gone, expired or deleted. Its capture URL then answers senders with 410.
wl.cli.trouble.exit5: Exit code 5: the state file cannot be read or written, or another forwarder uses it. Give each forwarder its own --state-file.
wl.cli.trouble.target: A failing local target is printed and counts as handled; the CLI keeps running. Check that your server listens on the port and the prefix.
wl.cli.trouble.path: A captured path that would leave the path prefix, for example through .., is refused.
wl.cli.trouble.repeat: Delivery is at least once: a crash between sending and saving the position can repeat one capture. Run with --dry-run first to see what would be sent.
